notes.blurb: The townhouse ring: dark timber frames between pale boards under grey tile, close-set and low; the plain end of the axis, one step above the farm ring.
notes.construction: exposed dark posts and lintels, boarded infill, latticed fronts to the street, tile over a shallow gable
notes.ground: the natural ground; a stone footing course under the boards
notes.roofs: gabled kirizuma tile roofs, shallow, eaves upturned, one tier
notes.signature: the latticed street front under a low tiled gable
